title: When Does Superposition-Attack Structure Enable Q1 Attacks?
summary: The offline Simon algorithm cannot attack schemes lacking a superposition-model attack, while the enabling algebraic structure makes a practical difference for Q1 attacks; the conditions and cross-scheme relationship remain open.

formal_statement.body: For a cryptographic scheme, determine and characterize when algebraic structure that enables an attack with superposition queries also yields a meaningful attack with classical queries and offline quantum computation, including whether such a relationship extends to schemes without a known superposition-query attack. The offline Simon algorithm cannot attack schemes that lack a superposition-model attack, while the algebraic structure enabling a superposition attack was observed to make a practical difference for classical-query attacks; the unresolved task is to identify the conditions under which this structure produces a meaningful Q1 attack and to characterize the relationship across schemes. [S1]

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of symmetric schemes across superposition-query and classical-query attack models with offline quantum computation.
parameters: query access model: superposition queries versus classical queries with offline quantum computation
algebraic structure: structure enabling a superposition attack and potentially yielding a meaningful Q1 attack
scope.unresolved_remainder: Identify the conditions under which the algebraic structure produces a meaningful Q1 attack and characterize whether the relationship extends across schemes, including schemes without a known superposition-query attack.

citations.label: Quantum Attacks Without Superposition Queries: The Offline Simon’s Algorithm

progress.summary: The source states that schemes without a superposition-model attack cannot be attacked by the algorithm and reports that the enabling algebraic structure makes a practical difference for Q1 attacks. It explicitly says that this question needs further investigation.
citation_labels: Xavier Bonnetain et al., Quantum Attacks Without Superposition Queries: The Offline Simon’s Algorithm
